agent_explanation: Emergency preemption at t=204 immediately forces EW green without completing the normal transition sequence. At step 203 NS is still in yellow (1s elapsed of 5s required) with no all-red. At step 204 EW is already green and NS red, meaning 0s of all-red elapsed (need 3s) and yellow was truncated to 1s. The emergency handler bypasses yellow_duration and all_red_clearance checks, causing both all_red_clearance and yellow_duration violations.
